title: Petra and the Letter
author: Elodie Lockridge
blurb: Sebastian Marchetti, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
